ARTIST.definition: A person known for creating or performing artistic work, such as an actor, musician, painter, or author.

ATHLETE.definition: A person who competes in a sport or athletic activity.

CLERIC.definition: A person who holds a religious office or performs religious duties.

POLITICIAN.definition: A person who holds or seeks elected or appointed political office, or is a notable political leader.

SCIENTIST.definition: A person identified for conducting or contributing to scientific research.

SPORTSMANAGER.definition: A person who manages, coaches, or directs a sports team or athlete.

OTHERPER.definition: A named person who does not fit the other MultiCoNER person subtypes.

FACILITY.definition: A named constructed place or site used for a particular purpose, such as a hospital, airport, or stadium.

HUMANSETTLEMENT.definition: A named place where people live, such as a city, town, village, or other settlement.

STATION.definition: A named transport or service station, such as a railway station or transit stop.

OTHERLOC.definition: A named geographical location that is not a facility, human settlement, or station.

AEROSPACEMANUFACTURER.definition: An organization that manufactures aircraft, spacecraft, or aerospace equipment.

CARMANUFACTURER.definition: An organization that manufactures cars or other motor vehicles.

MUSICALGRP.definition: A named musical group, band, orchestra, or comparable performing ensemble.

ORG.definition: A named organization or organized group that does not fit a more specific MultiCoNER group subtype.

PRIVATECORP.definition: A privately owned corporation or business organization.

PUBLICCORP.definition: A publicly traded corporation or public-sector corporation.

SPORTSGRP.definition: A named sports team, league, association, or other sports organization.

CLOTHING.definition: A named clothing item, apparel product, footwear item, or fashion product.

DRINK.definition: A named beverage product or branded drink.

FOOD.definition: A named food product, dish, or branded food item.

VEHICLE.definition: A named vehicle or vehicle product, excluding its manufacturer organization.

OTHERPROD.definition: A named consumer product that does not fit clothing, drink, food, or vehicle.

ARTWORK.definition: A named visual or physical artwork, such as a painting, sculpture, or other art piece.

MUSICALWORK.definition: A named musical composition, song, album, or other musical work.

SOFTWARE.definition: A named software program, application, operating system, or software package.

VISUALWORK.definition: A named film, television program, video, or other audiovisual work.

WRITTENWORK.definition: A named book, article, story, poem, document, or other written work.

ANATOMICALSTRUCTURE.definition: A named body part, organ, tissue, or other anatomical structure discussed as a medical entity.

DISEASE.definition: A named disease, disorder, or pathological condition.

MEDICALPROCEDURE.definition: A named medical examination, operation, diagnostic procedure, or treatment procedure.

MEDICATION_VACCINE.definition: A named medicine, drug, pharmaceutical product, or vaccine.

SYMPTOM.definition: A named symptom, sign, or manifestation of a disease or medical condition.
